features.name: any_comment_has_edit_eta_marker
features.definition: Does at least one counter-argument comment contain an explicit "Edit:" or "ETA:" section marker?
features.spec: Parse OC_comments as a JSON list of strings (null if missing/malformed; empty list -> 0). Return 1 if any comment matches regex r'(?i)\b(?:edit|eta)\s*:' ; else 0. Raw literal match on current text, not semantically filtered; may match non-revision uses and cannot confirm revision after posting.

h0: any_comment_has_edit_eta_marker has no association with the probability that the OP changed their view (delta).
h1: Rows with a counter-argument containing an Edit:/ETA: marker have a higher delta rate than rows without.
note: Persuasiveness is operationalized as the dataset outcome delta (row level, not per-comment; no per-comment outcomes are supplied). The marker is only a proxy for revision; edit timing is unknown. The marker is rare (~0.5% of rows in a quick check), so power is low. Edit text may include delta/outcome acknowledgements (e.g. 'Edit: !delta'), a contamination risk not filtered here. 'Substantially' has no threshold; the test is of direction/association only, not causation.
